annotations.title: Take a task off the pile

description: Claim a task and get its briefing in one call. Pass an `id` to claim a specific task, or omit it to claim the next open task (oldest open by createdAt then id). Atomically flips the task to "taken" and records takenBy/takenAt; errors if it's already taken or done. Returns the task and a get_context-style briefing for its part_of domain plus the concepts it realizes / is governed_by (with code_areas). complete_task marks it done.

id.description: Claim this specific task by id. Omit to claim THE next open task (oldest by createdAt then id).

takenBy.description: Label for who's claiming it (agent/orchestrator name). Defaults to a generic label.
